why.title: Telephone sales come with strict requirements, and the evidence is in the call
why.item1Title: The customer must accept in writing
why.item1: In telephone sales to consumers, the agreement is often only binding once the customer has accepted the offer in writing after the call. Without a clear trail, the sale is easily disputed.
why.item2: Then someone has to find the recording, listen through the call and show what was actually said, offered and accepted.
why.item3Title: Nobody has time to listen to every call
why.item3: Managers and compliance hear a sample. Deviations are found late, and coaching is based on gut feeling.

how.title: How it works
how.step1: The seller records the call in the Sales studio, from the microphone or from the tab where the telephony solution or Teams is running. No installation, and no change of telephony system.
how.step2Title: Transcription while the call is in progress
how.step2: The text arrives within seconds, with timestamps and links to the audio. Over 60 languages, and a search that finds every call again.
how.step3Title: AI control against the product template
how.step3: Price, binding period, right of withdrawal, and approved and forbidden phrases are checked against the template for the product. The warning lamps turn green, yellow or red while the call is in progress, so the seller can put things right before the customer hangs up.
how.step4Title: The customer confirms with BankID or Vipps
how.step4: The customer gets a link, sees the offer with price, binding period and withdrawal deadline, and accepts or declines. Only the buyer can accept, and the evidence is stored so that it can never be changed.
how.step4Note: Add-on module. If you use your own system for confirmation, the seller pastes the call’s reference there.
how.step5: Every sale gets a note written by AI and complete documentation: the offer, the acceptance, the call, the transcript and the control. A complaint is handled with everything in one place.

features.title: Everything the call centre needs
features.intro: Modules are switched on per call centre, so you pay for what you use.
features.f1: Warning lamps per required point, live transcription, a note written while you talk, and a reference you paste into your own sales system.
features.f2: Price, terms, required points and forbidden phrases per product. Versioned, so every call is measured against the template that applied at the time.
features.f3: AI writes the note from your own note templates, in the language you choose. The seller can adjust it, and the AI version is kept.
features.f4: Customers, products and sales with a status flow and full history, linked to the calls.
features.f5: Recording, transcript, offer, acceptance and deviations are gathered into finished complaint documentation.
features.f6: The seller’s own figures, the team for the manager, the whole call centre for the admin, and a quality tab for compliance. Feedback goes straight to the seller.
features.f7: Create your own roles and grant permissions per role. Nobody can hand out more than they hold themselves.
features.f8: Users, teams, roles, invoices and messages to us, in one place for the call centre’s admin.

roles.title: Made for the whole call centre
roles.r1: Sees the lamps while the call is in progress, gets the note written, and never has to hunt for the call later.
roles.r2: Sees the team as a whole, who needs follow-up, and gives feedback on specific calls.
roles.r3: Works through the flags in a queue, builds the complaint case from the documentation, and sees who has opened which recordings.
roles.r4: Manages users, teams and roles, and sees usage and invoices.

trust.title: Built to be evidence
trust.intro: The documentation has to hold when someone disputes a sale. That is why VeriQall is built with tracking, encryption and access control from the ground up.
trust.t1: Recordings, transcripts and data are stored encrypted at AWS in Stockholm. Transcription takes place in the EU, and the AI control runs at AWS in the same region.
trust.t2Title: Each call centre sees only its own
trust.t2: Data is separated per call centre all the way down in the database, not just in the app.
trust.t3Title: Log in with BankID, Vipps and passkeys
trust.t3: Administrative tasks require a session started with BankID.
trust.t4: Every change is written to an audit log that cannot be altered, and every playback of a recording to an access log.
trust.t5: The customer’s acceptance is stored with the document the customer saw, the method, the time and a cryptographic checksum. A decided confirmation can never be changed.
trust.t6: Recordings are deleted automatically after 3 to 12 months, as you choose. National identity numbers are never stored in plain text.

faq.title: Questions and answers
faq.q1: Do we have to change our telephony system?
faq.a1: No. Recording happens in the browser, from the microphone or from the tab where the telephony solution runs. The sale is registered where you do it today, with the call’s reference pasted in.
faq.a2: You inform the customer about the recording as you do today. VeriQall stores the recording securely and deletes it automatically when the retention period ends.
faq.q3: Can we keep our own system for confirmation?
faq.a3: Yes. Sale verification with BankID and Vipps is an optional add-on module. Without it, you link the call to the sale with the reference.
faq.a4: The app in Norwegian, English, Swedish, Danish and German, and notes and AI control in the same languages. Transcription in over 60 languages.
faq.q5: Where is the data stored, and for how long?
faq.a5: Encrypted at AWS in Stockholm. Recordings are deleted automatically after 3 to 12 months, as the call centre chooses.
faq.a6: We create the call centre and invite your administrator. The admin invites the users, who sign in with Vipps or BankID. No installation, and you can be up and running the same day.
